item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 15/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will bring cold and dry weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week, but it will still be rather cool in the morning.

Date/Month: 16/01 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground in the morning.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and dry. Cold in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 11 - 15 C
R.H. range: 45 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 17/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly fine and dry. Cold in the morning.
Temp range: 11 - 16 C
R.H. range: 45 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
